title: BARRELS GO UP IN BOTH WINDOWS
why: Explosive barrels were never networked. Both windows place the same barrels (same ids and spots, the side stream), but a blast stayed in its own window: a barrel player 2 set off went up only on his screen and hurt no machine or pillager (his window returns before the bodies, which the host runs), the host still saw it standing, and a barrel that went up on the host (his shot, a charge or an enemy round) never went up for player 2 and never hurt him. Proven with eval in a staged pair: the host blast sent no word, and player 2 blast left the body beside it untouched with nothing sent. Now a barrel that goes up by its own fuse sends a small word (host to everyone, player 2 to the host, which passes it on); the other window blows its own copy with the sound, shake and flash, hurts its own player by the same no team damage rule, and on the host hurts the bodies with the kill to the seat that lit it (his own window marks those bodies as a blast, so the kill does not count the gun that hit last). The boom is heard once, by the sound word that already travels. Walls are not hit twice (they already travel), a barrel taken from the net sends nothing back, and one already gone takes nothing, so each barrel goes up once in each window.
now: In co-op an explosive barrel either player sets off now goes up on both screens, and a barrel player 2 shoots hurts the enemies by it, with the kill his.
